Chapter 1

Operating Principles and Safety Basics

WP OPS

Tools, scripts, and guides for modern WordPress development & devops—optimized for Trellis/Bedrock workflows.

Chapter Purpose

This chapter orients operators to the toolkit, showing what is included and where to start for common workflows.

Tools

Tool Description Documentation
Trellis Updater Safely update Trellis while preserving custom configurations → Guide
Backup Tools Ansible playbooks for database and files backup/push/pull operations → Guide
Provisioning Reference Common Trellis provisioning commands and workflows → Guide
New Machine Setup Set up macOS for Trellis development (tools, SSH, VM architecture) → Guide
Project Setup Clone and configure an existing Trellis/Bedrock project → Guide
Monitoring Nginx log monitoring for traffic analysis and security threat detection → Guide
Security WordPress protection via fail2ban automatic IP blocking and manual deny rules → Guide
Content Creation Automated page creation and WP-CLI content management workflows → Guide
Migration Tools Migrate WordPress sites to Trellis/Bedrock (single and multi-site) → Guide
URL Update Methods Generic WordPress URL update methods for migrations → Guide
Diagnostics WordPress diagnostic tools for transients, caching, and performance issues → Guide
Security Scanners Dual-scanner suite for WordPress malware detection and security auditing → Guide
Image Optimization Nginx WebP/AVIF configuration with automatic format serving → Guide
Browser Caching Nginx configuration for optimal static asset caching → Guide
Redirects Nginx redirect configuration for SEO and URL management → Guide
Troubleshooting Diagnose and resolve PHP-FPM, MariaDB, and server issues → Guide
PR Creation Script AI-powered GitHub PR descriptions with multi-AI backend support (Claude/Codex) → Guide
Theme Release AI-powered version bumping and changelog generation for WordPress themes → Script
Theme Sync Rsync script for theme synchronization → Script
Age Verification Cookie-based age verification system with modal interface and ACF integration → Guide
Analytics Implementation and detection of Google Analytics, Matomo, and other analytics tools → Guide
Speed Optimization Performance testing tools and TTFB analysis with curl/wget → Guide

Quick Start

Choose the tool you need and follow its dedicated guide for detailed setup and usage instructions.
